@sana Here are the table_of_contents design review notes from my handover: Anchors must be unique and match the ids the site renderer assigns: the first heading with a given slug keeps it, later ones get "-1", "-2", etc. appended in document order ("#faq", "#faq-1", "#faq-2"). The renderer numbers every heading, including headings hidden by max_level, so those still consume a number.
